#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Modernized Climate Data Analysis Script
Python 3 compatible version with modern APIs
"""

import configparser
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


class ClimateAnalyzer:
    """Modernized climate analyzer using Python 3 and modern libraries."""
    
    def __init__(self, config_path: str = "/app/climate_analyzer/config.ini"):
        """Initialize analyzer with configuration."""
        self.config = configparser.ConfigParser()
        self.config.read(config_path)
        self.data_cache = {}
    
    def load_temperature_data(self, filename: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        """Load temperature data from CSV file with UTF-8 encoding."""
        df = pd.read_csv(
            filename,
            parse_dates=['date'],
            encoding='utf-8'
        )
        return df
    
    def calculate_anomalies(self, temperature_series: pd.Series) -> np.ndarray:
        """Calculate temperature anomalies using modern NumPy/Pandas API."""
        baseline = temperature_series.mean()
        anomalies = temperature_series - baseline
        return anomalies.to_numpy()
    
    def create_visualization(self, data: pd.Series, title: str) -> None:
        """Create plots using modern matplotlib API."""
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        import matplotlib.dates as mdates
        
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
        ax.plot(data.index, data.values, 'b-')
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')
        
        # Modern date formatting
        ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m'))
        ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
        
        # Save with safe ASCII filename
        plt.savefig('/tmp/climate_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.close(fig)
    
    def run_analysis(self, data_path: str = "/app/climate_analyzer/sample_data/climate_data.csv") -> None:
        """Main analysis pipeline with Python 3 patterns."""
        print("Starting climate analysis...")
        
        try:
            # Load data from CSV
            data = self.load_temperature_data(data_path)
            
            # Process both stations using modern iterrows/items
            for station_id, group in data.groupby('station_id'):
                anomalies = self.calculate_anomalies(group['temperature'])
                
                # Calculate and print mean temperature for each station
                mean_temp = group['temperature'].mean()
                print(f"Station {station_id} mean temperature: {mean_temp:.1f}°C")
                
                # Generate title using modern f-strings
                title = f"Temperature Anomalies - Station {station_id}"
                self.create_visualization(pd.Series(anomalies, index=group['date']), title)
        
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error occurred: {e}")
            raise
        
        print("Analysis completed successfully!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Modern Python 3 main execution
    analyzer = ClimateAnalyzer()
    analyzer.run_analysis()
EOF
